name: Kanmi Girls Collection
original_name: 甘味ガールズコレクション
source:
In the world of Sweetaria, where girls known as “Sweets” live under divine blessings, the protagonist "Pâtissier" chooses a heroine to pursue—each leading to a unique ending.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3731130/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在被称为“糖果”的女孩们生活在神圣祝福之下的Sweetaria世界中，主角“糕点师”选择了一位要追求的女主人公，每一个都导致了一个独特的结局。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3731130/]Steam[/url]]
